newsitem.title: FINLAND: TULIKIVI SEES CLEARLY BETTER '96 EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: TULIKIVI SEES CLEARLY BETTER '96 EARNINGS.

text.p: Stone fireplace maker Tulikivi Oy said on Thursday it expected full-year 1996 earnings to improve clearly on last year.
"The group's result for the financial year is expected to clearly exceed last year's level," Tulikivi said in a statement with its January-August results.
In 1995, Tulikivi reported a 1.6 million markka profit before extraordinary items.
"Demand has turned into a rise in all of the company's markets," Tulikivi said.
The incorporation of Mittakivi Oy -- acquired by Tulikivi in August -- would help boost final tertial earnings, it said.
